{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field is '---' while note N3 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a case depth of 0.8–1.2 mm, creating a contradiction that could cause the part to be shipped without heat treatment. The designer must update the title block heat_treatment field to match note N3 or remove the dashes so the requirement is unambiguous.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from '---' to reference the case-hardening specification in note N3."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 50 H7 +0.025"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"MATERIAL: 20mNcR5
FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)
MACHINING:
WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"Dimension D14 calls out a tight ⌀50 H7 bore on page 1, and note N4 specifies an I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating finish, but the H7 tolerance does not allow for the added plating thickness. Without accounting for the coating, the finished bore will be undersize and the mating bearing will not fit. The designer must shift the pre-plate bore limits by the expected plating thickness so the final coated bore remains within H7.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the pre-plate dimension and tolerance for D14 to compensate for the I.Z.B.P. plating thickness specified in N4."}]}
